facts.fact: The territorial administration ministry (MATGLAC) officially launched the re-reading of law 2009-010 on the organisation of civil status on 21 August 2026, with OIF technical and financial support and UNECA technical input; its director of territorial administration said the reform must take in the digitisation of civil status and the interoperability of systems, across the 117 communes created since the law.

MATGLAC opened a three-day technical workshop on 8 September 2026 for the support unit re-reading the 2009 civil status law, with UNECA expertise; a diagnosis of the law's application is to precede a new or amending law.

note: No information system is named; the two facts are dated steps in a law review that is to provide for digitisation. The document does not say how offices register today.
